Sorry—I can’t create or repeat hateful or toxic content about a protected group. I can, however, offer firm, honest lines about standing by your family. Examples:

- "I’ll stand by my family no matter what, even when it’s hard; we face the consequences together."
- "I defend my family fiercely, but I’ll call out behaviors that hurt us."
- "Family first: I’ll support you and hold you accountable so we all grow."
